slides.title: Money can't buy happiness, but if you plow snow in winter, it can buy:
Plow truck registrations that are current before the first storm.
slides.body: Not renewed in a parking lot at 5 AM during it.

slides.title: A current insurance certificate, ready when the property manager asks.
slides.body: And they always ask the week of the first forecast.

slides.title: Handling the license renewals in November, while it's slow.
slides.body: Instead of finding the notice in March.

slides.title: A December where 'when does our policy renew?' has an answer.
slides.body: One that isn't 'let me check the glovebox.'
